purpose: Permanent source memory for worldwide Islamic-book and manuscript discovery. Sources are retained for future search; discovery never implies redistribution rights.
priority_rule: Known saved sources are searched before generic rediscovery. New sources discovered during acquisition must be appended rather than forgotten.

required_behavior: Search saved sources before generic web rediscovery.
Maintain source priority by work type, language, period and acquisition capability.
Do not infer redistribution permission from discoverability.
For rights-unclear sources, preserve provenance and use for discovery/review without public redistribution.
For manuscripts, prefer complete digital surrogate; OCR is search aid, never the authoritative witness.
Append newly discovered official national libraries, university libraries, Islamic libraries and language-specific repositories to this registry.

verified_web_notes.russian_state_library: RSL reports more than 50 million holdings in 367 languages and more than 3.3 million digital documents; its electronic library includes books and manuscripts.
verified_web_notes.national_library_russia: NLR exposes Oriental manuscript holdings and a Digital Manuscripts Library.
verified_web_notes.qatar: QNL repository includes rare Arabic manuscripts, early Arabic print and European-language material; QDL provides free online access to Middle Eastern historical sources and Arabic scientific manuscripts.
verified_web_notes.saudi_ministry: Saudi Ministry of Islamic Affairs provides an Islamic electronic library with books/materials and multilingual content.
verified_web_notes.foulabook: FoulaBook states that its platform includes public-domain works and that copyrighted books are published only with author/rightsholder permission; item-level rights must still be verified.
